description: Happy Tail admin panel feature registry

elements.name: email-input
elements.expected: Accepts staff email address input

elements.name: password-input
elements.expected: Accepts password input with masking

elements.name: login-button
elements.expected: Submits credentials. On success, redirects to /dashboard. On failure, shows error message.

elements.name: error-message
elements.expected: Displays error message on invalid credentials

/dashboard.description: Admin dashboard with business overview, today's schedule, and key metrics

elements.name: todays-schedule-summary
elements.expected: Shows summary of today's appointments and bookings

elements.name: metrics-cards
elements.expected: Displays key business metrics (revenue, bookings, active customers, etc.)

elements.name: recent-bookings
elements.expected: Shows list of recent bookings with status indicators

elements.name: quick-actions
elements.expected: Shows quick action buttons for common admin tasks

elements.name: nav-sidebar
elements.expected: Layout sidebar navigation is visible with links to all admin sections

/schedule.description: Daily/weekly schedule view of all bookings and appointments

elements.name: schedule-view
elements.expected: Displays schedule grid with bookings organized by time and resource

elements.name: day-view-toggle
elements.expected: Switches to day view showing detailed hourly breakdown

elements.name: week-view-toggle
elements.expected: Switches to week view showing overview of the full week

elements.name: date-navigation-prev
elements.expected: Navigates to previous day/week

elements.name: date-navigation-next
elements.expected: Navigates to next day/week

elements.name: booking-slot
elements.expected: Opens booking detail view or popover with booking information

elements.name: filter-by-service
elements.expected: Filters schedule by service type (daycare, boarding, grooming)

/customers.description: Customer management list with search and filters

elements.name: customers-table
elements.expected: Displays list/table of all customers with name, email, dogs, status

elements.name: search-input
elements.expected: Filters customers table by search query (name, email, phone)

elements.name: customer-row
elements.expected: Navigates to /customers/:id detail page for the selected customer

elements.name: pagination-next
elements.expected: Loads next page of customers

elements.name: pagination-prev
elements.expected: Loads previous page of customers

/customers/:id.description: Individual customer detail view with full profile, dogs, bookings, and messaging history

elements.name: customer-info
elements.expected: Displays customer profile: name, email, phone, registration date, loyalty tier

elements.name: dogs-section
elements.expected: Shows list of customer's registered dogs with breed, weight, and notes

elements.name: bookings-section
elements.expected: Shows customer's booking history with dates, services, and status

elements.name: points-section
elements.expected: Shows customer's loyalty points balance and tier

elements.name: edit-customer-button
elements.expected: Enables editing of customer profile information

elements.name: message-customer-button
elements.expected: Opens messaging thread with this customer or navigates to /messages

elements.name: back-to-list
elements.expected: Navigates back to /customers list

/grooming-pricing.description: Manage grooming service pricing tiers and options

elements.name: pricing-table
elements.expected: Displays pricing table with grooming services, sizes, and prices

elements.name: edit-price
elements.expected: Enables inline editing of a price or opens edit modal

elements.name: price-input
elements.expected: Accepts numeric price value input

elements.name: save-button
elements.expected: Saves updated pricing. Shows success confirmation.

elements.name: add-service
elements.expected: Opens form to add a new grooming service with name, description, and pricing

/bundles.description: Manage service bundle packages for upselling

elements.name: bundles-list
elements.expected: Displays list of all service bundles with names, included services, and pricing

elements.name: create-bundle-button
elements.expected: Opens bundle creation form or modal

elements.name: bundle-card
elements.expected: Opens bundle detail/edit view

elements.name: edit-bundle-button
elements.expected: Enables editing of bundle name, services, pricing, and availability

elements.name: toggle-bundle-active
elements.expected: Toggles bundle active/inactive status for customer-facing visibility

elements.name: delete-bundle-button
elements.expected: Opens confirmation dialog to delete the bundle

elements.name: save-bundle-button
elements.expected: Saves bundle changes. Shows success confirmation.

/staff.description: Staff member management (owner and admin only)

elements.name: staff-list
elements.expected: Displays list of all staff members with name, role, email, and status

elements.name: add-staff-button
elements.expected: Opens add staff form or invite modal

elements.name: staff-row
elements.expected: Opens staff member detail/edit view

elements.name: edit-staff-button
elements.expected: Enables editing of staff member details and role assignment

elements.name: role-selector
elements.expected: Dropdown to assign staff role (admin, manager, groomer, attendant)

elements.name: deactivate-staff
elements.expected: Deactivates staff account (does not delete, preserves history)

elements.name: save-staff-button
elements.expected: Saves staff member changes. Shows success confirmation.

/staff-schedule.description: Staff work schedule and shift management

elements.name: schedule-grid
elements.expected: Displays staff schedule grid with shifts organized by staff member and day

elements.name: add-shift-button
elements.expected: Opens form to create a new shift assignment

elements.name: shift-block
elements.expected: Opens shift detail for editing (start time, end time, assigned staff)

elements.name: week-navigation
elements.expected: Navigates to next/previous week in the schedule view

elements.name: staff-filter
elements.expected: Filters schedule to show specific staff member's shifts

elements.name: loyalty-settings
elements.expected: Displays loyalty program configuration (points per dollar, tiers, rewards)

elements.name: edit-points-rate
elements.expected: Allows editing of points earning rate (points per dollar spent)

elements.name: tiers-section
elements.expected: Shows loyalty tier configuration with thresholds and benefits

elements.name: rewards-section
elements.expected: Shows available rewards catalog with point costs

elements.name: add-reward-button
elements.expected: Opens form to create a new redeemable reward

elements.name: save-settings
elements.expected: Saves loyalty program changes. Shows success confirmation.

elements.name: customer-points-overview
elements.expected: Shows table of customers with their points balances and tiers

/gingr-sync.description: Gingr PMS integration sync status and controls

elements.name: sync-status
elements.expected: Displays current sync status (last sync time, connection health, error count)

elements.name: manual-sync-button
elements.expected: Triggers a manual sync with Gingr PMS. Shows progress indicator during sync.

elements.name: sync-history
elements.expected: Shows log of recent sync operations with timestamps and outcomes

elements.name: sync-error-details
elements.expected: Shows detailed error information for failed sync operations

elements.name: connection-test-button
elements.expected: Tests connectivity to Gingr API and reports result

elements.name: sync-settings
elements.expected: Shows sync configuration (interval, entity mappings, enabled data types)

/messages.description: Admin messaging panel for customer communication management with escalation controls

conversation-list.name: Conversation List
conversation-list.description: Shows all customer conversations with filter tabs for status management

elements.name: filter-all
elements.expected: Shows all conversations regardless of status

elements.name: filter-active
elements.expected: Filters to show only active/open conversations

elements.name: filter-escalated
elements.expected: Filters to show only escalated conversations requiring human attention

elements.name: filter-closed
elements.expected: Filters to show only closed/resolved conversations

elements.name: conversation-item
elements.expected: Opens the selected conversation in thread view

elements.name: escalation-badge
elements.expected: Shows visual indicator on escalated conversations

elements.name: search-conversations
elements.expected: Searches conversations by customer name, content, or topic

thread-view.name: Thread View
thread-view.description: Individual conversation thread with messages and admin action controls

elements.name: messages-thread
elements.expected: Displays full conversation thread with customer and AI messages

elements.name: reply-textarea
elements.expected: Accepts admin reply text input

elements.name: send-button
elements.expected: Sends admin reply message to the customer. Message appears in thread.

elements.name: assign-button
elements.expected: Opens staff assignment dropdown or modal to assign conversation to a staff member

elements.name: escalate-button
elements.expected: Escalates conversation to human attention. Sets escalated status and sends notification.

elements.name: de-escalate-button
elements.expected: Removes escalation status and returns conversation to normal AI handling

elements.name: back-button
elements.expected: Returns to conversation list (primarily on mobile responsive view)

elements.name: customer-info-panel
elements.expected: Shows customer info sidebar/panel with name, dogs, recent bookings

/ai-monitoring.description: AI conversation monitoring dashboard showing all AI-customer interactions

elements.name: conversation-table
elements.expected: Displays table of AI conversations with customer name, topic, status, satisfaction, and timestamp

elements.name: view-conversation-button
elements.expected: Navigates to /messages?conv=:id to view the full conversation thread in the messaging panel

elements.name: conversation-row
elements.expected: Selects the row or expands inline conversation preview

elements.name: filter-status
elements.expected: Filters conversations by status (active, escalated, resolved, closed)

elements.name: filter-date-range
elements.expected: Filters conversations by date range

elements.name: search-conversations
elements.expected: Searches conversations by customer name, content, or AI response topic

elements.name: escalation-stats
elements.expected: Shows metrics: total conversations, escalation rate, avg response time, satisfaction score

elements.name: refresh-button
elements.expected: Refreshes conversation data from the server
